data.rationale: The proposal matches the true workflow's four steps in order (DEALS, DEALS & PROMOTIONS, open the All Regions dropdown, choose a region) and names region as the parameter. It loses a point on feasibility because the last step lists example regions instead of saying "select {region}", though a browser automation could still be built from it.
